reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount helper (which already handles missing, numeric and ranged amounts) instead of re-implementing the rule.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the only new code is one field assignment and a type.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts, the layer that already maps schedules to the API shape.

scope.why: Touches only the API model, the handler type, a focused test and a release note.

maintainability.why: A one-line delegation to the canonical helper with a separate list type keeps future rule changes in one place.
